captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a front assembly for a BMX bicycle. It features a rigid black fork with two straight rectangular blades and a cylindrical unthreaded steerer tube. Clamped onto the steerer is a chunky black riser stem extending forward to a wide, two-piece freestyle handlebar set finished in light gray, complete with black hand grips.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a BMX front fork and handlebar assembly in CadQuery. The model should include a black fork with straight blades, a central steerer tube, a clamping riser stem, and light-gray freestyle handlebars with black end grips.
captions.factory: Construct the fork using rectangular extrusions for the blades, connected to a crown block and a vertical cylinder for the steerer tube. Create the stem by combining a cylindrical clamp collar around the steerer, a horizontal rectangular extension, and a front faceplate with bolts. Model the handlebars using swept or joined cylindrical segments to form the uprights, crossbar, and main bar, adding colored sleeves at the ends for the grips.
